A frog, about 10cm long, found sleeping (?) between the rocks of a stone wall being taken down near Proserpine, Queensland. When disturbed, it moved a bit, but did not go away. Even when fully exposed
Korallovaya litoria (lat. Litoria caerulea) is a frog of the genus of tailless amphibians of the family of tree frogs.
